page: OVHcloud b3-64 is a general-purpose cloud server powered by an AMD EPYC processor with the x86_64 architecture. It features 16 dedicated physical cores running at 2.3 GHz with a single thread per core, providing a direct one-to-one mapping of vCPUs to physical cores. The hardware configuration includes 64.0 GB of system memory, yielding 4.0 GB of RAM per core. Storage is provided via a local 400 GB NVMe SSD, and the network interface delivers a baseline bandwidth of 4 Gbps.

In benchmark evaluations, the server demonstrates strong single-core CPU performance and high memory bandwidth for large-block read and write operations, placing it in the top tier for these metrics. Multi-threaded bzip3 decompression and text generation for small language models also rank in the top 25%. Conversely, multi-core CPU performance, software compilation, database operations, and static web serving throughput fall within the average range.

The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing capabilities without resource contention, representing a balanced resource density for general-purpose workloads. While it lacks GPU acceleration and advanced matrix extensions, the inclusion of local NVMe storage and a complimentary public IPv4 address enhances its utility for database hosting, web serving, and moderate multi-threaded processing tasks.
